mentions.name: Bobby
mentions.description: This is a code review tool for pull requests focused on ergonomics. It renders files in organized trees/graphs generated from LSPs and symbol references instead of a linear file list, provides keyboard shortcuts for navigation, pan, zoom, commenting, noting, and submitting, is mostly GitHub-compatible with native features, offers LSP-powered symbol resolution for inspecting definitions and references, supports LLM-powered reviews, and includes inline LLM question answering.
